title: A scaling limit for the weighted mean square of the truncated Möbius divisor sum — Lean 4/Mathlib formalization
description: Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization companion to the manuscript "A scaling limit for the weighted mean square of the truncated Möbius divisor sum" (Rodrigo Menezes and Bernardo C Menezes, 2026). The development proves Theorem 1 of the paper end-to-end: the exact positive decomposition S(n) = (1/ζ(2))·∑_{d>n} μ(d)²/J₂(d) + ζ(2)·∑_{d≤n} J₂(d)·E_d(n)² and the explicit bound 0 ≤ S(n) < (1 + 4ζ(2))/n, for every integer n ≥ 1, with no sorry placeholders anywhere in the proved surface. Theorems 2 and 3 are stated but not yet proved: eleven declarations carry sorry, comprising the two de la Bretèche–Dress–Tenenbaum (2020) inputs (the uniform mean-square theorem and the global bound, neither currently in Mathlib), the fixed-block limit, the closed-form rearrangement and lower bound for the scaling constant C, Ramaré's identity, and the downstream deductions of Theorems 2 and 3 from these. The Dress–Iwaniec–Tenenbaum constant enters only as an opaque constant in three stubbed declarations and nowhere in the proved Theorem 1 surface. Toolchain: Lean 4.34.0 with mathlib v4.34.0, pinned in lean-toolchain and lake-manifest.json; continuous integration re-verifies the development on every push.
